School Holiday Bookings

For the summer school holiday period, from 19 December 2026 to 31 January 2027, the following booking parameters apply:

  • No arrivals permitted on Christmas Day or New Years Day
  • 19/12 – 15/01: 7-night minimum stay with Saturday arrivals and departure only on sites
  • 16/01 – 21/01: 6-night minimum stay with Saturday 16/01 arrival and Friday 22/01 departure only on sites
  • 12/12 – 31/01: 2-night minimum stay for studios and villas
  • 22/01 – 31/01: 2-night minimum stay for all sites

For the 2026 September school holiday period, from 25 September to 10 October 2026, the following booking parameters apply:

  • 25/09 – 27/09: 3-night minimum stay on all accommodation types with arrivals only permitted on 25/09
  • 28/09 – 10/10: 2-night minimum stay on accommodation types
School holiday bookings

For the 2027 September school holiday period, from 24 September to 9 October 2027, the following booking parameters apply:

  • 24/09 – 26/09: 3-night minimum stay on all accommodation categories with arrivals only permitted on 24/09
  • 27/09 – 09/10: 2-night minimum stay on all accommodation categories

Bookings will open for members on the 14 October 2026 and for non members on 16 October 2026. Visit our school holidays bookings page for more information on release times, terms, conditions and exclusions.
